card.name: Words just before a medical term
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word starts right before an expected medical term, such as 'including' before a procedure, 'intravenous' before steroids or fluids, and 'an' before a specialist. Often seen in capitalized emergency-treatment warnings.

modes.label: Emergency treatment lists
modes.description: Linking or partial words inside capitalized lists of emergency treatments.
modes.example: OXYGEN, INTRAVENOUS STEROIDS, AND AIRWAY MANAGEMENT,<< INCLUDING>> INTUBATION, SHOULD ALSO BE ADMIN

modes.label: Partway through a word before a medical term
modes.description: Part of a word where a medical word is about to be completed.
modes.example: Previously<< und>>iagnosed impaired glucose tolerance and overt

modes.label: Before a named specialist
modes.description: A linking word before a health professional or specialty.
modes.example: If I have trouble seeing I go to<< an>> optician etc etc.

card.writes: It pushes toward medicine-related words such as 'med' and 'treat' and away from 'phys' and 'orth' starts.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before a medical or treatment term is expected.
